title: DeFiRank: Federated Pairwise Ranking for Governance in Decentralized Financial Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.12916v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing governance approaches in decentralized financial networks rely on manual review processes conducted by human committees, which introduces subjective bias, creates a scalability bottleneck under high network volume, and fails to capture complex behavioural patterns and evolving network dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose \name, a federated learning-based pairwise ranking framework in which multiple institutions collaboratively train a ranking model without sharing their private transaction data. This collaborative learning enables the model to capture network-wide behavioural patterns that signify strong network participation and directly contribute to the network effect, including diversity of counterparties, usage of multiple applications, and frequency of transactions. translated_title: DeFiRank：面向去中心化金融网络治理的联邦成对排序框架
translated_abstract: 现有的去中心化金融网络治理方法依赖于人工委员会进行的手动审查流程，这会引入主观偏见，在高网络交易量下造成可扩展性瓶颈，并且无法捕捉复杂的行为模式和不断演变的网络动态。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了DeFiRank，一个基于联邦学习的成对排序框架，多个机构可以在不共享其私有交易数据的情况下协同训练排序模型。这种协同学习使模型能够捕捉到体现强网络参与度并直接促进网络效应的全网行为模式，包括交易对手的多样性、多个应用的使用情况以及交易的频率。该系统根据提供者行为的真实性对其进行排名，提升真正贡献者的排名，并降低表现出可疑行为者的排名。
tldr: DeFiRank提出了一种基于联邦学习的成对排序框架，使多个机构无需共享私有交易数据即可协同训练模型，通过捕捉交易对手多样性、多应用使用和交易频率等全网行为模式来评估提供者行为的真实性，从而实现去中心化金融网络中自动化且可扩展的治理。
en_tdlr: DeFiRank is a federated learning-based pairwise ranking framework that enables multiple institutions to collaboratively train a ranking model without sharing private transaction data, capturing network-wide behavioural patterns such as counterparty diversity, multi-application usage, and transaction frequency to rank providers by the authenticity of their actions for scalable governance in decentralized financial networks.
